answer: Each epoch auctions 40 admission slots in the orchard, one per identity. Sealed bids post to a public meadow ledger. Winners pay and it burns; losers keep their stake. Bids from one key escalate: first 55, the k-th 55+7(k-1). A falcon auditor replays bids, burning any rented-bid ring sharing one key. Forging 1,000 identities costs 3,551,500 against a 40,000 pool, a loss of 3,511,500. An honest agent pays 55 once, keeping its full share.
